environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). ALB has access logging enabled to S3 but no rule-based filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to ALB, ALB to instance on 8080. SQLite database stored on EBS volume mounted at /data. API keys distributed to internal teams via Secrets Manager.
